environment.gpu_time: Not measured; API-call elapsed/thread-CPU times only.
environment.concurrent_load: Owned local test/build processes were stopped during performance capture. The ordinary desktop remained active; remote Windows policy tests overlapped the final stream trials.

notes: Sample recognition CPU includes text policy; elder recognition CPU measures the core resume API. Compare changes within each application.
Warm-up is excluded from per-update distributions; recognition/render counters include initial processing.
Video latency is frame arrival at the capture process, not physical display latency.
Video state-order regressions are retained, including those seen on the old SDK. These trials do not pass the monotonic-order acceptance criterion.
CPU frequencies sampled after visual acknowledgement include idle; per-frame samples are separate. No frequency-normalized global improvement percentage is inferred.
GL calls retain their existing synchronization; no added glFinish or immediate GPU query wait.
Detailed and control runs are separate groups. Control runs keep completion/marker logging but omit per-frame stage clocks.

108 serialized trials plus one partial failed trial. No video-order failure has been removed from the report. First visual appearance is used for latency even when an older state is subsequently observed.

Sequential mode checks all 41 recognition completions and 40 subsequent visible states. Stream mode coalesces intermediate work and checks recognition completion and the same final text after update 60.
These are temporary comparison binaries. Neither elder-terms source nor its pinned boxrig reference was changed.
The sample policy probe records completed work and empty event queue but does not count matches separately. Zero-match counts are verified by the core comparison and elder event probe.
